goalTextEn: Can understand a simple phone call at work.
goalTextKr: 직장에서의 간단한 전화를 들을 수 있다.

introduce.goalEn: Can understand a simple phone call at work.
introduce.goalKr: 직장에서의 간단한 전화를 들을 수 있다.
introduce.situationEn: The office phone rings. Listen to who is calling and what they want.
introduce.situationKr: 사무실 전화가 울립니다. 누가 전화했는지, 무엇을 원하는지 들어 봅시다.

tutorNotes.text: "Today, we will practice can understand a simple phone call at work.."
Read the lesson goal aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
"Is it clear?"
Read the situation. Check the student understands.
"Let's go to the next part."
On the phone, clarity is more important than speed.

patterns.kr: 이 씨(이 과장님)와 통화할 수 있을까요?

vocabulary.definition: used to identify yourself on the phone
to connect a call to another person/line

pronunciation.instruction: Phone clarity: speak slowly and clearly (name, company, request).
pronunciation.instructionKr: 전화 발음: 이름/회사/요청을 천천히 또박또박 말해 봅시다.

words.en: May I speak to Mr. Lee?

tutorNotes.text: "Let's learn the key phone and email phrases."
Read each pattern aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
Teach vocabulary with short examples.
"Now, let's practice pronunciation."
Model polite tone and clear speech.

understand.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct pattern. Then practice the pattern drills.
understand.instructionKr: 빈칸에 올바른 표현을 넣고, 패턴 드릴을 연습하세요.

examples.en: May I speak to Mr. Lee?
May I speak to the manager?

patternDrills.label: Ask to wait
patternDrills.template: One moment, please. / Please hold on.

tutorNotes.text: Do the fill-in-the-blank first.
Run drills with substitutions.
Focus on correct pattern choice and clarity.

steps.title: Step 1 - Repeat After Me
steps.content:
1. Hello. This is Mina speaking.
2. May I speak to Mr. Lee?
3. One moment, please.
4. Please hold on.
5. I will transfer you.
6. Thank you.

tutorNotes.text: Read each line clearly and model phone voice.
Remind the student to slow down and articulate.

steps.title: Step 2 - Personalize It
steps.instructionEn: Complete the lines using your own context.
steps.content:
1. Hello. This is _______________ speaking.
2. May I speak to _______________?
3. One moment, please.
4. Please hold on.
5. I will transfer you to _______________.
6. Thank you.

tutorNotes.text: Have the student fill in first, then read aloud.
Use realistic names, departments, and times.

steps.title: Step 3 - Dialogue Practice
steps.instructionEn: Practice this dialogue with your tutor.

dialogue.en: Good morning. May I speak to Mr. Lee?
dialogue.kr: 안녕하세요. 이 과장님과 통화할 수 있을까요?

dialogue.en: Please hold on. I will transfer you.

tutorNotes.text: Do it once reading, then once naturally.
Keep phone responses short and clear.

steps.title: Step 4 - Free Speaking
steps.instructionEn: Speak freely using at least 5 sentences.
steps.content:
Include:
- Say your name clearly
- Ask to speak to someone
- Ask the caller to wait
- Use transfer once
- Close politely

tutorNotes.text: "Try a realistic phone/email role-play."
Give feedback after the student finishes.

challenge.scenarioEn: You answer three short calls. Identify the caller, ask them to wait, and transfer or take a note.
challenge.scenarioKr: 짧은 전화 3통을 받습니다. 통화 요청을 듣고, 기다려 달라고 말하고, 연결하거나 메모하세요.

tutorNotes.text: "Challenge time. Keep your phone voice clear."
Success = clear intent + polite patterns + correct key details.

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category and answer the questions.

categories.title: PHONE MANNERS
questions: Do you answer phones at work?
What is hard on the phone?
Do you prefer calls or messages?

categories.title: CLARITY
questions: How can you speak more clearly?
Do you repeat names on the phone?

categories.title: CALL SITUATIONS
questions: What do you say when you cannot hear well?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, a short discussion."
Read the instruction.
Ask the student to choose a category.
You can ask follow-up questions and have a natural conversation with the student until the time for feedback.
